name: Peter Ilketshall Gooch

conflicts.siteValue: Tree chain Peter 'Ilketshall' Gooch -> William Gooch (1523-1605) -> 'Wyllyam' Gooch (1559-1636) as the Tuthill in-laws
conflicts.foundValue: Henry Tuthill of Tharston's will (20 Mar 1618, proved 20 Apr 1619) names his wife's father as JOHN Gooch and her mother as Margaret Rau(e); Akerly prints the wife only as 'Alice (Gooch?)'.
conflicts.assessment: The documented father-in-law is John Gooch, not William. Nothing ties the tree's 'Peter Ilketshall Gooch' (1490-1558) to Alice Gooch. 'Ilketshall' is a Suffolk place name (the Ilketshall parishes near Bungay) used as a middle name, a typical sign of a merged online tree. Treat as unsupported.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: No source supports this person's place in John's tree; the only primary-derived evidence (Henry Tuthill's will) names John Gooch. Recommend flagging as unsupported / detaching unless a Gooch pedigree is found.

openQuestionsNew: Is there any record linking a William Gooch of Ilketshall/Wissett to John Gooch of Long Stratton, father of Alice Gooch (bapt. Long Stratton 11 Aug 1583 per WikiTree)?

sources.citation: Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), p. 3-4
sources.supports: Henry Tuthill's will names 'John Gooch, father' and 'Margaret Rau, mother-in-law'; wife Alice (Gooch?)

searchedNoResult: Akerly 1898 full text: 'Gooch' occurs only in Henry Tuthill's will abstract (John Gooch); no William or Peter Gooch
researchLogEntry: Round 4: Akerly's abstract of Henry Tuthill's 1618 will names John (not William) Gooch as father-in-law; the William/Peter 'Ilketshall' Gooch chain is unsupported.
